title: University in Vigan City clarifies: No armed student on campus

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — The University of Northern Philippines (UNP) in Vigan City said a report claiming a student brought a firearm on campus was untrue, based on an investigation undertaken by the university administration. In a statement on Friday, the university said it conducted a thorough investigation into the reported gun presence and found no basis for the claims. UNP said the safety and well-being of its students, faculty, staff, and visitors remain its top priority, and it is taking steps to maintain a safe and secure campus.
